verdict.rationale: Dropbox docs confirm basic folder/file sharing with viewer vs editor access levels (dropbox-docs-24, dropbox-docs-31, dropbox-docs-9), but there is no evidence of a full permission model (commenter, owner roles) or documented inheritance behavior for nested folders/files. missing for 10: commenter/owner role definitions, explicit inheritance rules for sub-folders/files, and admin-level permission management documentation.
